name: plan_colored_top_down_grasp
summary: Compose colored-object geometry, gripper contracts, TCP compensation, and chained IK into an executable top-down grasp plan.

generality.rationale: The combo handles varied colored rigid tabletop objects without object-class code, but inherits HSV segmentation and top-down parallel-jaw assumptions.
assumptions: The target is the largest connected component of a supported color.
The target rests on a locally horizontal visible support.
A top-down parallel-jaw grasp through its geometric center is suitable.
limitations: Does not handle arbitrary semantic categories, cluttered same-color instances, side grasps, suction, or deformables.
IK waypoints are checked but the continuous path is not collision planned.
A successful test lift still requires visual or contact verification.

level.rationale: It is an orchestration layer that captures one observation and composes two reusable perception and planning subsystems into ordered action stages.

composition.strategy: Pass a single RGB-D geometry estimate into the object-agnostic profile-aware top-down grasp planner.

provenance.failure_gap: Qwen needed a bounded high-level action that bridges successful color localization to legal reachable grasp stages without hiding reusable lower-level skills.
evidence: iter_001 localized red, green, and blue blocks but failed before any verified grasp
